subject: Approval request: Hosted API strategic concession for NovaCommercial (>25% discount)

Subject: Pricing question: Hosted API volume discount

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Hosted API latency profile looks like a great fit for how we plan to serve embeddings at scale. We ran some internal numbers and are evaluating Redwood against two other vendors.

Quick question: our procurement lead is pushing for a material concession on per-token pricing given the committed volumes we're targeting (rough estimate: 6-9B tokens/month over the first 12 months). What kind of off-list discount can Redwood offer on Hosted API usage for a strategic partner commitment?

To be explicit: we're looking at something north of 20% to make the math work versus our incumbent. We also have a preference to include co-marketing and a case study if we proceed.

Can you send a written concession (percent + conditions) so we can move this into procurement?

Best,
Emma Chen

NovaCommercial

Subject: Fwd: Pricing question: Hosted API volume discount — request for exec concession (>25%)

Team — forwarding Emma's note from NovaCommercial. She explicitly called out >20% as a gating item; procurement wants a written concession to compare against incumbent.

Why this matters: NovaCommercial is in final evaluation for their AI platform (large national retailer vertical). They estimate 6-9B tokens/month first year; projected hosted spend at list is roughly $1.1M-$1.6M ARR. They are offering a co-marketing pilot and reference if we can meet their price expectations.

Ask: can we provide a concession in the 25-35% range on Hosted API usage with conditions (12-month minimum committed spend or MRC)? I need an exec signoff to move forward — procurement wants the number by Friday 6/30 EOD PT.

Attached: NovaCommercial_MAAP_v3.pdf (proposed usage profile) and a quick pricing_comparison.xlsx that models spend at different discount levels.

Notes: I have built in assumptions for prefix caching and token mix (mostly short prompts+embeds). If we approve a larger concession, recommend requiring a firm commit (monthly minimum) and an onboarding success metric tied to latency targets.

Thanks — Ben

Thanks for the context, Ben. A few items I need before we can sign off on anything >20%:
1) Confirmed ARR math and margin at proposed discount tiers (25%, 30%, 35%) — finance needs per-token gross margin estimates.
2) Precedent: are we comfortable with committing this concession for a hosted (not dedicated) deployment? Any SLA risks or capacity prioritization asks?
3) Terms: minimum committed monthly spend and breakage/true-up mechanics.

Laura — can you pull the margin calc in the attached pricing_comparison.xlsx and annotate the acceptable floor? Marissa — I'd like your assessment on strategic value / co-marketing lift.

If the numbers work and we can tie a firm 12-month MRC, I'm inclined to approve up to 30% for a strategic case; anything >30% needs C-level review.

-Rishi

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-06-30 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing question: Hosted API volume discount — request for exec concession (>25%)

Rishi / team — I ran the numbers in pricing_comparison.xlsx. Summary (rounded):
- List ARR at projected usage: $1.35M
- 25% discount: ARR = $1.0125M, estimated gross margin ~38%
- 30% discount: ARR = $0.945M, estimated gross margin ~30%
- 35% discount: ARR = $0.8775M, estimated gross margin ~24%

Recommendation: Approve a 30% Hosted API concession with the following conditions:
- 12-month committed monthly spend (MRC) equal to 75% of the projected monthly token volume (with quarterly true-ups)
- Case study + 1 co-marketed webinar within first 6 months
- Standard Hosted SLA, no dedicated capacity guarantee (we will reserve burst capacity but not dedicate GPUs)
- Legal adds a standard termination clause with 60-day notice if they materially breach commit

Rationale: At 30% we maintain acceptable margin and capture strategic customer value (large reference, potential marketplace listing). Anything deeper materially impacts unit economics for hosted.

If you want, I can draft the commercial clause for DocuSign and include the MRC language.

-Laura
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma.chen@novacommercial.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-30 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Redwood concession approved (30% off Hosted API) — DocuSign link

Emma — good news: Rishi and the commercial team have approved a 30% concession on Hosted API usage for NovaCommercial under the conditions below. Apologies for the back-and-forth and thanks for your patience.

Approved concession and conditions (summary):
- 30% off list per-token Hosted API pricing for the first 12 months
- 12-month minimum committed monthly spend (MRC) = 75% of projected monthly tokens (quarterly true-up)
- No dedicated capacity guarantee; Redwood will provide burst capacity and meet standard Hosted SLA
- Co-marketing commitment: 1 case study + 1 webinar within 6 months
- Standard legal termination clause with 60-day notice on material breach

I've attached the MAAP and the price model for your records. Please review and sign via DocuSign here: https://www.docusign.com/en/sign/ABCDEF. Our commercial counsel will draft the exact language into the SOW once we have the signed concession.

If procurement needs the formal HubSpot deal id, it's ND-20280630-0123. We want to get this signed by end of week to lock pricing.

Thanks — excited to partner on this.

Best,
Ben Carter
